drivingQuestion: How is threshing in a consecrated field meila if meila requires detached items?
outcomeNote: Ravina resolves via benefit from the dust

segments.he: הַדָּשׁ קַלְעִילִין בִּשְׂדֵה הֶקְדֵּשׁ – מָעַל. וְהָא בְּתָלוּשׁ בָּעִינַן! אָמַר רָבִינָא: שְׁמַע מִינַּהּ אַבְקַהּ מְעַלֵּי לַהּ.
segments.en: The Gemara discusses a similar case: «One who threshes» his non-sacred «kalilin,» a type of legume, «in a consecrated field» is liable for «misuse» of consecrated items. The Gemara raises a difficulty: «But» in order for one to be liable for misuse, «we require» the consecrated item from which one derives benefit to be «detached» from the ground, whereas the field is the ground itself. «Ravina said: Conclude from it» that the field’s «dust is beneficial for» kalilin, and therefore he misuses the detached dust of the consecrated field when he threshes it.
